display_long_description:
rust taggers is an action-packed virtual reality tag experience where your hands are your only way to move. Inspired by skill-based locomotion systems, players run, climb, launch, and glide through dynamic environments using pure physical movement. No joysticks for walking — just momentum, technique, and control.

Every match is a test of agility and awareness. Whether you're chasing down opponents or escaping by scaling structures and mastering tight movement routes, rust taggers rewards precision, quick thinking, and practice. The more you play, the smoother and faster you become.

Designed for both competitive players and newcomers, rust taggers blends intense multiplayer tag gameplay with immersive environments that keep every round fresh and exciting. Easy to learn but challenging to master, the game offers endless replayability as you refine your movement skills and outplay your opponents.

Warm up your hands, sharpen your reflexes, and jump into the chase — rust taggers is tag like you’ve never experienced before.
